args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.0) in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.
